natural_language_instruction: Spawn in survival mode. The sun is going down — you have roughly 10 in-game minutes before mobs start spawning. Gather at least 8 oak (or any wood) logs, craft 16 wood planks, and place them as a 1-block-thick enclosed shelter (4 walls + roof, minimum 3x3 footprint) before nightfall. Door optional. Stay alive: bot.health > 0 throughout.
success_criteria: shelter encloses bot's spawn area on all 4 sides + roof, 1 block thick
